hou: Birds of prey fly swift and fierce
The east wind thaws the ice
Fish rise, carrying ice on their backs
The earth is damp, the heat heavy
Sparrows enter the sea and become clams
Pheasants enter the sea and become giant clams
Heaven's qi rises, earth's qi sinks
All is closed off, and winter sets in

youli.name: Shangguan Youli
youli.line: I've read the Analects three times, and each time I found I'd misread it the time before.

zhaojin.name: Kong Zhaojin
zhaojin.line: Reading the Analects is like sketching from life: look at it line by line, and the man stands up off the page.

shouzhuo.name: Lin Shouzhuo
shouzhuo.line: I've bound the Analects hundreds of times. This time I'd like to open it and read.

luchuan.name: Lu Chuan
luchuan.line: The Analects: two thousand five hundred years, and its price has never dropped.

liuqi.name: Ruan Liuqi
liuqi.line: The rites in the Analects? I came to understand them through my feet, dancing.

shahela.name: Shahela
shahela.line: I came from the west, and the Analects was the first Chinese book I studied.

lisa.name: Lisa
lisa.line: Woof! Shouzhuo's corgi, in a blue-green headscarf. She won't settle down to sleep until everyone's here.
